commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Shea Lacey (Manchester United).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

89' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Leny Yoro (Manchester United) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar! The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
88' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

87' Solly March (Brighton) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Senne Lammens has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
85' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
82' Michael Carrick decides to make a substitution. Luke Shaw will be replaced by Tyrell Malacia (Manchester United).
79' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.
77' Shea Lacey (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Jack Hinshelwood will be replaced by Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
74' Noussair Mazraoui comes off the pitch to be replaced by Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
74' Michael Carrick has decided to substitute Mason Mount and he is replaced by Tyler Fletcher (Manchester United).
74' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bryan Mbeumo.
70' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) commits a rough foul. Samuel Barrott stops the game and makes a call.
66' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
64' Pascal Gross (Brighton) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
62' Here's the change. Patrick Dorgu leaves the pitch and Shea Lacey (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
59' An attempted cross from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cleared.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Baleba (Brighton) will replace James Milner.
59' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Solly March (Brighton) replacing Diego Gomez.
59' Substitution. Danny Welbeck leaves the pitch and is replaced by Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton).
57' Diego Gomez (Brighton) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
53' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Manchester Utd players have a reason to celebrate!
50' The Manchester Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

48' 0 - 3 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a short pass from Patrick Dorgu in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
47' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' Fabian Hurzeler makes a half-time substitution. Yankuba Minteh comes on in place of Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
45+3' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) sees a yellow card from Samuel Barrott after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45+2' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Senne Lammens, who smothers the ball.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' 0 - 2 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) scores after an assist by Amad Diallo that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:2.

40' Diego Gomez (Brighton) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
38' Pascal Gross (Brighton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

35' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
33' 0 - 1 Bruno Fernandes takes the corner and Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) manages to jump the highest in the box and plants a precise header in off the crossbar. The score is 0:1.
32' Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

32' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' The ball possession is 52:48.

28' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
22' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
20' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
18' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
15' James Milner (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.

13' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
11' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
9' Diego Gomez (Brighton) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
4' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Mason Mount (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
1' Diego Gomez (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
